heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
PURSUE Launches — 162 Declassified Files Released at war.gov/UFO
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. The Department of War launched the PURSUE program on May 8, 2026, releasing the first tranche of 162 declassified UAP files — 120 PDFs, 28 videos, 14 images from FBI, DoD, NASA, and State Department. Highlights include 1969 Apollo 11 crew debriefings in which Buzz Aldrin describes an unexplained object near the moon and mysterious cabin light flashes, plus military memos from Iraq and Syria and foreign diplomatic cables. The official statement says files show 'no indication of U.S. government interaction with beings from other planets.' Rep. Luna called it 'a huge step in the right direction' but confirmed her 46 whistleblower-identified videos were NOT included — expected in Tranche 2 within 30 days. Nine days remain until Trump's May 20 EO milestone.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
